last_result.headline: Q57 augmented the DP state to (TVT, dip) so a sustained dip costs nothing, directly targeting Q54's over-damping. Degeneracy control exact. The first smoke was exactly inert and the cause was priced: the dip's payoff is DEFERRED while its penalty is immediate, so a greedy beam prunes it -- Q55's protective suboptimality seen from the other side, now blocking a better model from being explored. With per-dip beams (which give the augmented arm 5x the baseline's search) the augmented DP finds STRICTLY LOWER OBJECTIVE COST AND STRICTLY WORSE RMSE on every arm, and the path deviation stays at 3.1 ft against 16.3 ft of truth. That inverts Q54's framing: the over-damping is not a defect the transition model imposes, it is what the emission prefers and the protection Q55 identified. The alignment DP is now closed on four sides -- emission, transition, decoder, and state space.
